login.description: Sign in with the admin token printed by the server at startup (or configured via the ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable).

list.emptyDescription: Create one on the left to get started.
list.deleteDescription: "{{name}}" and all of its rules will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.

detail.noneDescription: Select or create a ruleset to edit it.
detail.urlHint: Use this address as the rule subscription URL in your client. It is public (editing requires the admin token); with read protection on, requests without the key get nothing.
detail.protectOn: Read protection enabled; the public URL was updated
detail.protectOff: Read protection disabled; the public URL no longer needs a key

auth.expired: Token is invalid or expired; please sign in again
